hero.eyebrow: For the moments you wish were easier
hero.heading: The little things
hero.copy: That daily hassle you barely notice anymore. The routine you'd love to simplify. We believe a thoughtful find can make everyday moments feel a little lighter—and knowing if it's right for you should be simple.
hero.concept_alt: Illustrative scene of a desk organizer, smartphone and an open parcel.

principles.label: What matters to HiParcelo
principles.useful_copy: Ideas that begin with familiar, everyday frustrations.
principles.clarity_copy: A closer look is part of making a choice that feels right.
principles.help_copy: A clear place to ask when you want to know more.

discovery.heading: Imagine the easier moment.
discovery.copy: You know the feeling: you spot an idea and immediately picture where it could fit into your life. We love that moment. We also believe the practical details should make just as much sense as the idea itself.
discovery.concept_alt: Illustrative scene of a hand placing a pen in a sage-green organizer on a desk.
discovery.life_copy: A small frustration. A task that takes more effort than it should. A moment you'd like to improve.
discovery.detail_copy: A thoughtful idea can make you look at your everyday routine in a whole new way.
discovery.choice_title: And the details make it yours.
discovery.choice_copy: The fit, the intended use and the full picture help you choose without feeling rushed.
discovery.price_details: Find the available options, full costs and delivery information on the product page.

about.heading: Less noise. Better discoveries.
about.copy: There are plenty of things you could buy. We're interested in the ones worth considering. HiParcelo is taking a focused approach to practical finds: understand the problem, appreciate the possibility, and make the details easy to see before deciding.

help.label: Know what to expect and how to get help
help.delivery_copy: Delivery details, when an offer is ready.
help.contact_copy: We're here to hear what's on your mind.

faq.heading: Confidence lives in the details.
faq.copy: Curiosity starts the journey. Clear answers make the next step feel easier.
faq.products_question: What kind of things will I find here?
faq.products_answer: We're shaping HiParcelo around useful ideas for familiar everyday moments. Our first offer is being prepared; the current images are concepts, not products available to order.
faq.delivery_question: Will I know when my order should arrive?
faq.delivery_answer: Before orders open, we'll provide the supported destinations, handling and delivery estimates, and applicable costs for each actual offer. An estimate won't be presented as a guarantee.
faq.returns_question: What if something isn't right for me?
faq.returns_answer: We'll provide the applicable cancellation and return rights, procedure and costs before purchases begin. Clear terms matter more than vague promises.
faq.help_question: What if I still have a question?
faq.help_answer: Reach us at the email below. Whether it's about fit, intended use or delivery, it's always worth asking.

closing.heading: Discovering something useful should feel good.
closing.copy: And understanding it should feel just as easy. Get to know the thinking behind HiParcelo.

common.preview: Our first find is taking shape. Ordering isn't open just yet.
common.support_copy: Something on your mind? Reach out. We'll be clear about what we can confirm.
common.question: The little details make a difference.
common.concept: Concept illustration — not a selected product
common.offer_pending: Our first offer is in preparation

form.heading: What's on your mind?
form.intro: Sometimes it's one detail that makes all the difference. Tell us what you'd like to know about HiParcelo, and we'll be clear about what we can answer.
form.name: Your name
form.success: Your message has been submitted. Keep an eye on the email address you provided.
form.error: Please check the highlighted fields and try again.
form.notice: Please do not include payment-card details, passwords, identity documents or sensitive health information.
form.preview: Form preview only. Submission is disabled until our support destination has been checked.
form.response: Our support availability will be published before orders open.

tracking.heading: Follow the parcel. Keep the clarity.
tracking.intro: Your order's own status page is the place for confirmed updates.
tracking.step_one_copy: Choose the order-status link in the confirmation sent when your order was placed.
tracking.step_two_copy: Tracking appears once a shipment has been created. A label alone does not mean the parcel is moving.
tracking.step_three_copy: Use our contact page and include your order number. Never share your password or payment details.
tracking.account_copy: If your order is linked to a customer account, sign in to see it.
tracking.no_lookup: We do not show order information from an order number alone. Use your secure order-status link or contact us for help.
tracking.prelaunch: No live tracking service is connected to this preview. Shipment events will come from authenticated order data; no example events are presented as real.

product.fit: Check the fit before you choose
product.fit_copy: Read the dimensions, materials, compatibility and care details for the actual product. Ask us if anything is unclear.
product.no_product_copy: This is the reusable product-page layout. Choose the first product in the theme editor after the offer has been verified.
product.offer_note: Review the total price, delivery availability and return conditions before ordering.
product.prep_copy: This product page is a preparation preview. Purchase controls are disabled.
product.preview_title: Good things can begin with one little idea.
product.preview_copy: We're starting with one focused find, chosen around a familiar everyday need. When it's ready, we'll share the real product details and what to expect—so the excitement doesn't come with unnecessary guesswork.
product.preview_problem: It begins with a familiar feeling
product.preview_problem_copy: The moment you think: there must be a simpler way to do this. That's the kind of question we want to start with.
product.preview_proof_copy: A good first impression is just the beginning. Photos, intended use, dimensions and limitations matter too.
product.preview_fit_copy: Think about your space, your routine and what matters to you. The right details make that picture clearer.
product.preview_service_copy: When we're ready to sell, the price, destination, delivery and return details will be available alongside the offer.

faq.heading: Good questions. Clearer answers.
faq.intro: The things worth knowing when you're getting to know a new brand.
faq.brand_a: HiParcelo is being shaped around familiar everyday problems and thoughtful possibilities. We're preparing one focused first offer.
faq.order_a: Not just yet. We're taking time to prepare our first offer and the details that go with it. You'll know when it's available.
faq.products_q: Is the item in your imagery for sale?
faq.products_a: Not yet. Our current images illustrate the brand direction. We'll show actual product information when the first offer is ready.
faq.delivery_q: Where do you deliver and how long will it take?
faq.delivery_a: We're confirming the first destination and delivery route. Before any purchase is possible, we'll show the actual processing and delivery estimates, available locations and applicable charges.
faq.returns_a: Before orders open, we'll explain the applicable cancellation rights, return steps, costs and refund process clearly on the relevant pages.
faq.tracking_q: How can I track an order?
faq.tracking_a: Once orders are available, the secure order-status link in your confirmation email will show available tracking information. We won't invent delivery events.
faq.support_a: You can use the Contact page or write to hiparcelo@gmail.com. If it's about an order, include the order reference when possible.
faq.health_a: Our general guides aren't medical advice. Products involving health or safety claims require their own specific review before sale.
faq.feedback_a: When there's genuine customer feedback, we can show it honestly. We don't invent reviews, customer counts or ratings.

password.copy: We're preparing HiParcelo's first everyday find. Clear information, a thoughtful offer and help within reach.

cookies.intro: Understand the actual services before choosing how information is used.

guides.intro: The best part of finding something clever is knowing it actually makes sense for you.

guide_fit.intro: A good idea feels even better when you know it fits your space, routine and needs.

guide_before_ordering.intro: A few simple questions help turn a first impression into a choice you can feel comfortable with.

guide_use_and_care.intro: The most satisfying part of a good find is knowing how to use it well.
